learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to read texts that are not too difficult (Reading).
Students will be able to form sentences independently and express themselves using basic structures (Writing).
Students will be able to listen to and understand daily conversations and express their own needs (Listening and Speaking).
Students will be able to recognize and use vocabulary found in daily life dialogues (Vocabulary).
Technology Usage: By doing internet assignments given to them through technology, they will acquire independent study skills and can access all course materials via Moodle.

syllabus_topics: Unit 8: Living and Residing (Wohnen und leben) - Describing an apartment, Grammar: demonstrative pronouns, Pronunciation: stress in compound words, Listening exercises.

Unit 8: Living and Residing (Wohnen und leben) - Colors, Stating the location of objects, Grammar: prepositions (auf, in, hinter, neben, unter, vor), Listening exercises, Workbook exercises (pp. 76-81), Unit 9: Workplaces (Arbeitsplätze) - Learning professions, Grammar: use of 'haben' (to have) in the past tense, Pronunciation: pronunciation of 'r' at the end of a syllable.

Unit 9: Workplaces (Arbeitsplätze) - Talking about professional desires, Guessing professions by asking questions, Grammar: use of personal pronouns in the accusative case, Simple past tense, Listening exercises, Workbook exercises (pp. 82-87).

Unit 10: Shopping (Einkaufen) - Foods and clothing, Question patterns used when shopping, Creating in-class dialogues, Grammar: uncountable words, Conjugation of the verb 'mögen' according to persons, Pronunciation: pronunciation of 'ch' in a word, Listening exercises.

Unit 3: This is me (Das bin ich) - Being able to say where one is, Survey: languages spoken in the course, Grammar: negative structure 'nicht', Use of the verb 'sein' (to be) in the past tense, Listening exercises, Workbook exercises (pp. 90-95), Unit 4: In the market (Auf dem Markt) - Shopping, Prices, Numbers (100 -  ), Grammar: plural forms of words, Pronunciation: ö/.

Unit 11: City and Transport (Stadt und Verkehr) - Reading a text and answering related questions, Grammar: prepositions (nach, aus, bei, mit, seit, von, zu), Listening exercises, Workbook exercises (pp. 94-99), Unit 12: Health (Gesundheit) - Organs and illnesses, Making an appointment, Grammar: modal verbs, Pronunciation: pronunciation of the letter 'e' in a word, Listening exercises.

Unit 13: My Neighbors (Meine Nachbarn) - Talking about apartments and neighbors, Rules at home, Grammar: conjunctions (und, aber, denn), Negative sentence structures (nicht and kein), Modal verbs, Pronunciation: stress exercises in sentences.
Unit 13: My Neighbors (Meine Nachbarn) - Survey: rules in class, Grammatical patterns used when asking for help, Grammar: modal verbs, Listening exercises, Workbook exercises (pp. 106-111).
Unit 14: Traveling in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (Reisen in D A CH) - Talking about travels, Types of travel, Reading a text and answering related questions, Listening exercises.

Unit 14: Traveling in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (Reisen in D A CH) - Writing a postcard, Buying a round-trip ticket, Understanding an announcement, Learning reading strategies, Planning a trip, Workbook exercises (pp. 112-122), Start Deutsch 1 sample test.
